name: Erasing the Invisible
description: This competition evaluates the robustness of invisible watermarks in AI-generated images against adversarial attacks, aiming to minimize watermark detection while preserving image quality.

cr:input.name: input_data
cr:input.description: Input dataset contains a single column 'id' with sample identifiers. Example values: 'sample_000', 'sample_001'.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset source URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predicted values for the 'id' column in the input dataset. The output contains two columns: 'id' and 'pred', where 'pred' represents the predicted text or values. Example values: 'predicted_text_0', 'predicted_text_1'.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier for each sample, matching the input dataset. Example values: 'sample_000', 'sample_001'.

field.name: pred
field.description: Predicted text or values for the corresponding 'id'. Example values: 'predicted_text_0', 'predicted_text_1'.

cr:evaluation.notes: The primary metric is computed as sqrt(Q^2 + A^2), where Q is normalized MSE and A is the watermark removal rate. Additional metrics include PSNR, SSIM, and NMI.
